lines.zh: 海蚀柱的坡很陡，爪子得抠紧。
lines.en: The sea stack is steep; my claws must dig in.

lines.zh: 黑色的鳞片，晒久了会发亮。
lines.en: Black scales shine after long hours in the sun.

lines.zh: 浪打上来，脚下这块石头是湿的。
lines.en: The waves reach up; this stone under me is wet.

lines.zh: 沿着柱边绕一圈，看看潮位。
lines.en: Circle the stack's edge to check the tide level.

lines.zh: 从这块石跳到那块石，差一点。
lines.en: Jumping rock to rock, and just barely making it.

lines.zh: 海水溅到背上，很快就干了。
lines.en: Seawater splashes my back and dries quickly.

lines.zh: 往下走，去有海藻的那一侧。
lines.en: Heading down to the side where the seaweed grows.

lines.zh: 尾巴在水里划，比在岸上灵活。
lines.en: My tail steers better in water than on land.

lines.zh: 石头上全是盐，走起来发涩。
lines.en: The stone is crusted with salt and feels rough.

lines.zh: 风大，趴低一点再走。
lines.en: The wind is strong; crouch low before moving.

lines.zh: 这条路只有一条脚掌宽。
lines.en: This path is only one foot wide.

lines.zh: 太阳落下去前，得回到高处。
lines.en: Before the sun sets, I must get back up high.

lines.zh: 溅起的水花打在脸上，凉的。
lines.en: Splash hits my face, cool and sharp.

lines.zh: 柱顶那块平台，是我常去的地方。
lines.en: The flat top of the stack is where I often go.

lines.zh: 我朝海那一侧慢慢爬。
lines.en: I crawl slowly toward the sea side.

lines.zh: 背上的鳞被太阳晒得发烫。
lines.en: The sun bakes the scales on my back.

lines.zh: 趴在柱顶，让风把盐吹干。
lines.en: Lying atop the stack, letting the wind dry the salt.

lines.zh: 鼻子里喷出水，喷了两次。
lines.en: Two sharp snorts blew the seawater from my nose.

lines.zh: 晒着晒着，背上的盐结成白霜。
lines.en: Basking long enough, salt frosts white on my back.

lines.zh: 海水在下面撞石头，一直响。
lines.en: The sea keeps hitting the rock below, endlessly.

lines.zh: 四肢摊开，抓牢石面。
lines.en: Splayed limbs grip the rock surface.

lines.zh: 黑鳞吸热，身体很快就暖了。
lines.en: Black scales absorb heat, warming me quickly.

lines.zh: 有只海鸟落在旁边，各晒各的。
lines.en: A seabird landed nearby; we bask separately.

lines.zh: 潮水退了，露出一圈湿石头。
lines.en: The tide went out, exposing a ring of wet stone.

lines.zh: 眼睛半睁，盯着浪的节奏。
lines.en: Eyes half open, I watch the rhythm of the waves.

lines.zh: 把尾巴盘在身侧，省点地方。
lines.en: I curl my tail at my side to save space.

lines.zh: 风里全是咸味，闻久了也习惯。
lines.en: The wind is all salt, and I am used to it.

lines.zh: 这块石头被晒了一整天，还温着。
lines.en: This stone has baked all day and is still warm.

lines.zh: 打喷嚏，把鼻孔里的盐喷掉。
lines.en: I sneeze to blow the salt from my nostrils.

lines.zh: 等潮水涨回来，再下去觅食。
lines.en: I wait for the tide to return before going down to feed.

lines.zh: 你在船上，还是一直在看我。
lines.en: You are on a boat, yet you keep watching me.

lines.zh: 船身晃，你的影子也跟着晃。
lines.en: The boat rocks, and your shadow rocks with it.

lines.zh: 我黑得像礁石，你差点没看见。
lines.en: I am black as the reef; you nearly missed me.

lines.zh: 别把船靠太近，柱子会撞坏。
lines.en: Do not bring the boat too close; you will hit the stack.

lines.zh: 幼时你帮我揭过背上的旧皮。
lines.en: When I was small, you peeled the old skin off my back.

lines.zh: 鼻孔里的盐，你别学。
lines.en: Do not copy me and snort salt from your nose.

lines.zh: 你在拍照？我侧一下身。
lines.en: Taking a picture? Let me turn my side.

lines.zh: 我抬头，是因为你挡住了太阳。
lines.en: I look up because you are blocking my sun.

lines.zh: 水里和岸上，我都在看你。
lines.en: Both in water and on land, I keep an eye on you.

lines.zh: 你站那么久，腿会晒伤的。
lines.en: Stand there much longer and your legs will burn.

lines.zh: 皮很厚，但这一下还是进去了。
lines.en: My hide is thick, but that still got through.

lines.zh: 黑鳞翻起来，露出底下的肉。
lines.en: A black scale peeled up, showing flesh beneath.

lines.zh: 我喷了口气，疼得发抖。
lines.en: I snorted out a breath, shaking from the pain.

lines.zh: 往水里一沉，盐水反而压住了疼。
lines.en: Sinking into water, the salt somehow dulls the pain.

lines.zh: 爬回柱顶，路上歇了三次。
lines.en: Climbing back to the top, I rested three times.

lines.zh: 尾巴垂下，划水没力气。
lines.en: My tail hangs down, too weak to paddle.

lines.zh: 这一下打在侧腹，喘不上气。
lines.en: That hit my flank and knocked the breath out of me.

lines.zh: 身上多了道口子，风一吹就疼。
lines.en: A new gash stings whenever the wind blows.

lines.zh: 趴着不动，等身体自己修。
lines.en: I lie still and let my body repair itself.

lines.zh: 别靠近，我现在容易咬人。
lines.en: Stay back; I am quick to bite right now.

lines.zh: 海藻的味道飘上来了。
lines.en: The smell of seaweed drifted up to me.

lines.zh: 那种绿藻，我只在水下吃。
lines.en: That green algae I only eat underwater.

lines.zh: 你得把海藻放进水里，我才好拿。
lines.en: Put the seaweed in the water so I can take it.

lines.zh: 别拿海带逗我，我会跳下去。
lines.en: Do not tease me with kelp; I will dive for it.

lines.zh: 潮池里那一片，是我的份。
lines.en: That patch in the tide pool is my share.

lines.zh: 闻起来有点咸，正好。
lines.en: It smells salty, which is just right.

lines.zh: 我咬一口，得嚼很久。
lines.en: One bite and I chew for a long while.

lines.zh: 水下吃更安全，岸上太显眼。
lines.en: Eating underwater is safer; the shore is too exposed.

lines.zh: 你退后，我才肯靠近食物。
lines.en: Step back, and only then will I approach the food.

lines.zh: 这一口带沙，我吐掉了。
lines.en: That mouthful had sand in it, so I spat it out.

lines.zh: 你的桨碰到我的石头了。
lines.en: Your paddle bumped my rock.

lines.zh: 浪把我推过来，不是我要撞你。
lines.en: The wave pushed me into you; I did not mean to.

lines.zh: 被撞得滑进水里，又爬回来。
lines.en: Knocked into the water, I climbed back up.

lines.zh: 让开一点，我要跳过去。
lines.en: Give me a little room; I need to jump across.

lines.zh: 黑色的皮蹭花了，会留印。
lines.en: My black hide got scuffed and will show a mark.

lines.zh: 你踩在盐壳上，声音很脆。
lines.en: You stepped on the salt crust; it cracked sharply.

lines.zh: 撞上柱壁，爪子替我撑住了。
lines.en: I hit the stack wall, and my claws held me.

lines.zh: 船一晃，整片石头都在动。
lines.en: The boat lurched, and the whole rock seemed to move.

lines.zh: 我从你腿边过去，别收脚。
lines.en: I am passing by your leg; do not pull your foot in.

lines.zh: 退两步，水边太滑了。
lines.en: I back up two steps; the water's edge is slick.

lines.zh: 潮水低的时候，沙岸最合适。
lines.en: At low tide, the sandy shore suits us best.

lines.zh: 我挖的坑，离水线三步远。
lines.en: The pit I dug is three steps from the waterline.

lines.zh: 你身上的盐比我的厚。
lines.en: You carry a thicker crust of salt than I do.

lines.zh: 一起下潜，我带你走藻多的地方。
lines.en: Dive together, and I will show you where the algae grows.

lines.zh: 晒着同一块柱石，慢慢靠近。
lines.en: Basking on the same stack stone, we edge closer.

lines.zh: 蛋埋在沙里，潮水冲不到。
lines.en: The eggs are buried where tides cannot reach.

lines.zh: 黑色的头靠在一起，看不出来两只。
lines.en: Two black heads together look like only one.

lines.zh: 钻水时别急，先吸一口气。
lines.en: Do not rush the dive; take a breath first.

lines.zh: 守到小崽子自己能爬石头。
lines.en: We guard them until the hatchlings can climb rocks.

lines.zh: 风大的时候，躲到我这一侧。
lines.en: When the wind is strong, shelter on my side.

lines.zh: 抓我的时候，我全身都绷紧了。
lines.en: When you grab me, my whole body goes rigid.

lines.zh: 别捏尾巴根，那里正好在蜕皮。
lines.en: Do not grip the tail base; that is where I am shedding.

lines.zh: 身上全是湿的，会弄湿你。
lines.en: I am soaked all over and will wet you.

lines.zh: 托住胸口，我的爪子就不乱抓。
lines.en: Support my chest and my claws will stop scrabbling.

lines.zh: 离开石头，我有点不安。
lines.en: Away from the stone, I feel a little uneasy.

lines.zh: 你的手比晒过的石头凉。
lines.en: Your hand is cooler than sun-baked stone.

lines.zh: 放我回柱子上，那里有风。
lines.en: Put me back on the stack, where there is wind.

lines.zh: 我喷了下鼻子，是紧张。
lines.en: My snort just now was nerves.

lines.zh: 别举高，我想看见海。
lines.en: Do not lift me high; I want to see the sea.

lines.zh: 带我去别的岛？先看看水有多深。
lines.en: Take me to another island? First, how deep is the water?

lines.zh: 水下有东西游近海藻区。
lines.en: Something is swimming toward the algae bed.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，鼻孔张开了。
lines.en: I raise my head and my nostrils flare.

lines.zh: 那影子贴着海底，不是鱼群。
lines.en: That shadow hugs the seabed and is not a school.

lines.zh: 它在我的晒台上方绕。
lines.en: It is circling above my basking ledge.

lines.zh: 先站直，把身体撑大。
lines.en: Stand tall first and make my body look big.

lines.zh: 喉部鼓起来，是低吼前的样子。
lines.en: My throat swells, the way it does before a low hiss.

lines.zh: 潮池那边动静不对。
lines.en: Something is off at the tide pool.

lines.zh: 我盯住它，先不动。
lines.en: I lock eyes on it and hold still.

lines.zh: 它要是上柱，我就往下跳。
lines.en: If it climbs the stack, I will jump down.

lines.zh: 风把它的味道带过来了。
lines.en: The wind carried its scent to me.

lines.zh: 贴着石壁绕，保持高度。
lines.en: Circle along the rock wall, keeping the high ground.

lines.zh: 先嘶一声，把嘴张到最大。
lines.en: First a hiss, mouth opened as wide as it goes.

lines.zh: 它靠近水线，我就下潜。
lines.en: If it nears the waterline, I dive.

lines.zh: 潜到水下，从另一侧浮起。
lines.en: Dive under and surface on the other side.

lines.zh: 水里的速度比岸上快。
lines.en: I am faster in water than on land.

lines.zh: 尾巴压低，随时转向。
lines.en: Tail held low, ready to turn.

lines.zh: 它一迟疑，我就往前半步。
lines.en: The moment it hesitates, I take half a step forward.

lines.zh: 别把它逼到死角，会咬人。
lines.en: Do not corner it; cornered things bite.

lines.zh: 等潮水帮忙，把它推远。
lines.en: Let the tide help and push it away.

lines.zh: 眼睛不眨，盯着它的动作。
lines.en: I do not blink; I watch its every move.

lines.zh: 尾巴抽水面，响声先吓它。
lines.en: My tail slaps the water, and the sound scares it first.

lines.zh: 咬住它的鳍，往礁石上拖。
lines.en: Bite its fin and drag it toward the reef.

lines.zh: 爪子扒住它的壳，翻过来。
lines.en: Claws pry its shell until it flips.

lines.zh: 在水里打，我比它灵活。
lines.en: Fighting in water, I am the more agile one.

lines.zh: 被夹住尾巴，我转身甩开。
lines.en: When it clamped my tail, I spun and threw it off.

lines.zh: 这一口不深，但够它退。
lines.en: This bite is not deep, but it will make it retreat.

lines.zh: 打一下，沉到水里躲。
lines.en: One strike, then sink into the water to hide.

lines.zh: 盐水流进伤口，两边都疼。
lines.en: Salt water gets into the wounds, and both of us sting.

lines.zh: 它退了，我就回石头上晒。
lines.en: It retreated, so I return to the stone to bask.

lines.zh: 喘着气，鼻孔一张一合。
lines.en: Panting, nostrils opening and closing.

lines.zh: 从沙里拱出来，满嘴是咸沙。
lines.en: I pushed out of the sand with a mouthful of salt.

lines.zh: 第一口气，先喷掉鼻孔里的沙。
lines.en: First breath: blow the sand out of my nostrils.

lines.zh: 柱子在头顶，比我想的高。
lines.en: The stack looms above, taller than I expected.

lines.zh: 黑色的身体，在石头上很显眼。
lines.en: My black body stands out on the pale stone.

lines.zh: 爬几步就滑下来，再来。
lines.en: I climb a few steps, slide back, and try again.

lines.zh: 潮水刚好到脚边，凉。
lines.en: The tide reaches my feet, cool and quick.

lines.zh: 先看看哪块石头晒得最久。
lines.en: First, find which stone has baked the longest.

lines.zh: 尾巴还软，甩不动水。
lines.en: My tail is still soft and cannot slap water.

lines.zh: 头上有海鸟，得躲一下。
lines.en: A seabird is overhead; I should hide.

lines.zh: 记住涨潮前要回到高处。
lines.en: Remember to be up high before the tide comes.

lines.zh: 海都烫了，我往石头背风处躲。
lines.en: Even the sea is hot; I hide on the lee side.

lines.zh: 从柱上滑下来，一路刮着石头。
lines.en: Sliding down the stack, scraping stone the whole way.

lines.zh: 潜太久了，胸口发紧。
lines.en: I stayed under too long, and my chest tightened.

lines.zh: 石头碎了，碎片打在身上。
lines.en: The rock shattered and fragments struck my body.

lines.zh: 有一根刺扎在肩上，甩不掉。
lines.en: A spike is stuck in my shoulder and I cannot shake it.

lines.zh: 水里的味道变了，鳞片发麻。
lines.en: The water's taste changed, and my scales went numb.

lines.zh: 海藻被浪卷走了，两天没吃。
lines.en: The waves tore away the algae; two days without food.

lines.zh: 雷落在柱顶，我的爪子都麻了。
lines.en: Lightning hit the stack top and my claws went numb.

lines.zh: 石头没了，海也没了。
lines.en: The stone is gone, and so is the sea.
